rights.edition: OEWS May 2025, metropolitan area estimates, annual mean wage (data type 04)
rights.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics

vetted.notes: Read through the BLS public API, which needs no key for a few hundred series a day; bls.gov itself refuses scripts.

caveats: A mean over a whole occupation group: software developers earn more than the computer occupations' mean, support technicians less.
No public-sector split for a metro area: public-sector work reads the all-occupations mean.
